items.body:
So fun to do DealBook with my friend and partner of 11 years, @gdb. Thrilled the world got to see the brilliant, fiercely determined leader I have the privilege of working with every day.

Greg’s role at OpenAI has evolved from writing code 100 hours a week in the early days to now leading some of the hardest and most consequential parts of our business.

One thing that has not changed is his extraordinary commitment to our mission. I can say with confidence that OpenAI would not exist without Greg, and I believe the world would be on a much worse path toward the AI future without him.

translation.body:
和相交 11 年的朋友兼搭档 @gdb 一起做 DealBook，非常开心。很高兴全世界终于看到了我每天有幸与之共事的这位才华横溢、意志坚定的领导者。

Greg 在 OpenAI 的角色，已从早期每周写代码 100 小时，演变为如今主导我们业务中一些最艰难、影响最重大的部分。

不变的是他对我们使命的非凡投入。我可以有把握地说，没有 Greg 就没有 OpenAI，而且我相信，若没有他，世界走向 AI 未来的道路会糟糕得多。
translation.label: 机器翻译

items.body:
6.2 Sol and Astra are out.

These models can do amazing things and are very token-efficient; we hope people will get great value from them.

In particular, 6.2 Sol ultrafast is something I think people will really enjoy.

quote.text: GPT-6.2 Sol & Astra are *finally* here. We've also expanded ultrafast to Pro 200 plans for GPT-6.2 Sol, it's my go-to model for most day to day things.
